def transform(grid):
    # Fill the inside of a rectangular frame with alternating concentric layers.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 5]
    if not cells:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    # The outer frame encloses a rectangle; create an inset ring pattern.
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            d = min(r - r0, r1 - r, c - c0, c1 - c)
            out[r][c] = 2 if d % 2 == 1 else 0
    return out
PY

    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    max_depth = min((r1-r0)//2, (c1-c0)//2)

                out[r][c] = 0
